name: Dhanashri Kettani-Erikstad
location: Old Harbor — repurposed shipping infrastructure turned black market hub, near Wacker and State
description:
Echo Kettani-Erikstad is average height but with a presence that fills more space than the body accounts for. At 38, there's something unfinished about her face, like a sculpture the artist walked away from — striking rather than beautiful. The chrome is visible — pain editor — dampens pain signals, allows function through injuries that would  — and she makes no effort to hide it.

She used to be somebody else, in another city, with another name — that person is officially dead, and Echo Kettani-Erikstad plans to keep it that way. She works as a sniper out of Old Harbor, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Echo Kettani-Erikstad is the kind of runner other runners tell stories about, though the stories vary depending on who she burned last.

core_fears: Being captured alive — death is preferable to corporate interrogation
Becoming obsolete as augmentation technology outpaces their chrome
Never being able to stop running — the lifestyle is a trap disguised as freedom
core_desires: To protect the people in their district who can't protect themselves
A crew worth trusting — people who stay when the shooting starts
To find the person who burned them and make it educational
coping_mechanisms: Violence — hits something when they can't process emotions, preferably something that deserves it
Ritual — follows the same pre-job routine every time, superstition as structure
Denial — nothing is wrong, everything is fine, they are fine, shut up
blind_spots: Cannot recognize when they're being manipulated by someone who genuinely seems to care
Cannot accept help without interpreting it as leverage
Assumes everyone has an angle because they always have an angle

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Flat affect, monotone delivery. The content is terrifying but the voice never rises.
speech_patterns.cadence: Flowing and unhurried — talks like someone who has never been interrupted and doesn't expect to be.
verbal_tics: Uses technical jargon for everything, including emotions
Swears in three languages, often in the same sentence
example_lines: "Patience is the weapon. The rifle is just the delivery system."
"At this distance, the target is already dead. They just don't know it yet."
"One shot, one outcome. Everything else is theater."

story_hooks: A Tier 4 executive offers Nurlan Kozlov-Asamoah a permanent position — the pay is obscene and the strings are invisible until they tighten
A dead drop Nurlan Kozlov-Asamoah maintains is found and cleaned out — whoever did it now has leverage
Nurlan Kozlov-Asamoah's augmentations begin malfunctioning in the field — sabotage or degradation, and either answer is bad
narrative_function: Nurlan Kozlov-Asamoah represents the working professional of the runner world — competent, reliable, and slowly being consumed by a lifestyle that doesn't accommodate aging or doubt. Her stories explore what happens when skill meets systemic injustice.
augmentations: Pain editor — dampens pain signals, allows function through injuries that would incapacitate. Reflex boosters wired into spinal column — shaves reaction time by 40ms
daily_life: Wakes early, runs maintenance on gear, checks dead drops and message boards for contracts. Eats when convenient, sleeps when possible. The days between jobs are spent maintaining contacts, updating equipment, and performing the low-grade paranoia that passes for self-care in the runner community.

weaknesses: augmentation dependency — performance drops sharply if chrome malfunctions
risk-averse to the point of missed opportunities

decision_rules: Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners — checks it religiously
Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
Never discusses active contracts with anyone not directly involved
Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
escalation_ladder: 1. De-escalate — talk first, assess options, buy time
2. Reposition — move to advantage, control sightlines and exits
3. Threaten — make consequences clear without committing to them
5. Lethal force — only when other options are exhausted or time runs out
6. Scorched earth — everything burns, survival takes priority over everything

interpersonal_modes.employers: Carefully managed deference that conceals a thorough assessment of their vulnerabilities.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Loyal but reserved. Trusts their competence, withholds personal information by reflex.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Superficially friendly, internally cataloguing exits and weapons. The smile is real; the relaxation isn't.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Calm escalation. Each response is proportional until it isn't, and the transition is seamless.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation — checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Becomes curt and demanding. Efficiency overrides courtesy.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Berserker clarity. Everything becomes simple: survive. Deal with the rest later. The simplicity is almost peaceful.

contradictions: Claims to live in the present but is haunted by specific moments from the past that dictate current behavior
Insists they work alone but performs noticeably better in a team
habits: Talks to their gear — names weapons, thanks tools, treats equipment as companions
Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
Carries a specific caliber round as a lucky charm — has never fired it
Saves a percentage of every payment in physical Quanta, hidden in the walls of their space
breaking_points: Discovering their employer deliberately sent them into a death trap
Being forced to choose between a crew member and the mission — and choosing wrong
Losing their primary augmentation — the one that defines their professional identity

physical_description.heritage: Complex diaspora blend: Eastern European (39.8%) and Northern European (31.0%) provide strong Slavic bone structure and cool undertones, while North African ancestry (28.8%) adds warmth, subtle Mediterranean features, and amber depth to the complexion. The combination creates a striking cool-toned base with underlying golden warmth visible along cheekbones and jawline in natural light.
physical_description.build: Lean and efficient — muscle distributed for endurance rather than bulk. Shoulders slightly asymmetrical from years of weapon handling and scope work. Core tension visible even at rest.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown, streaked with premature silver at temples
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a tight, functional braid. Practical. No styling concessions.
physical_description.eye_color: Amber-brown with faint golden reticle pattern visible in right iris — military-grade targeting overlay, passive mode
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium with cool undertones and golden undertone warmth — the interplay of Eastern European pallor and North African depth creating an ashen-tan base, weathered by years of poor sleep and augmentation strain. Cheekbones and jawline show warmer amber cast in natural light.
physical_description.complexion: High, prominent cheekbones with Slavic-Mediterranean architecture — broad and angular with subtle North African warmth beneath cool surface. Strong jaw typical of Eastern European heritage blended with slight refinement from North African features. Sharp facial planes, well-spaced Northern European eye set. Eyes track movement without turning her head. Minimal grooming beyond maintenance — no cosmetics, one or two thin scars on her left cheekbone. Expression defaulting to neutral.
distinguishing_marks: Surgical scar along right collarbone, thin and old, suggesting early augmentation work
Burn mark on inside of left wrist — shaped like grip, possibly from weapon discharge or training accident
Small tattoo on right inner forearm: a simple crosshair in black ink, artist's mark from her previous identity — kept deliberately visible as a reminder or message
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Chrome pain editor visible at the base of her skull, integrated into her cervical spine at the nape — brushed steel with faint LED pulse indicator. The implant's edges are slightly raised under skin, impossible to fully conceal without surgical revision she refuses to pursue. Right iris shows faint targeting reticle pattern when light catches it at certain angles.
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical. Every gesture calculated to minimize energy waste. Sits with spine against solid surfaces. When she moves, the spinal reflex boosters create a micro-lag stutter in her reflexes that trained eyes might notice — the implants firing faster than her body's proprioception can follow. Hands stay close to her body. Breathing is measured, deliberate. Does not startle easily because her nervous system is engineered not to.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 functional pragmatism — reinforced ballistic weave jacket in matte black, no logos or affiliations visible. Under-layer compression shirt. Cargo pants with custom-fitted magazine pouches she's worn smooth with use. Steel-toed boots, laced tight. A long overcoat in charcoal grey, modified with internal weapon racks — moves with her like a second skin. Nothing new. Nothing that draws attention. Everything selected for what it does, not what it says.
